examples.en: Lions and tigers are typical beasts of prey.
I saw news that a fierce animal escaped from its cage.

examples.ko: 산에서 맹수를 만나면 등을 보이면 안 돼요.
examples.en: If you meet a fierce animal in the mountains, don't turn your back.
Beasts of prey catch their food with sharp teeth.
That player ran like a wild beast on the field.
At the zoo, they give meat to the beasts of prey.

explain: 사자, 호랑이, 늑대처럼 사납게 다른 동물을 잡는 동물에게 써요. 경기에서 아주 강하고 거칠게 움직이는 사람을 '맹수 같다'고 비유하기도 해요. 얌전한 동물은 '순한 동물'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I was afraid I might meet a beast of prey in the forest.
phrases.nuance_ko: 위험한 동물과 마주치는 상황에서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when running into a dangerous animal.

phrases.example: 그 선수는 경기 중에 맹수 같아요.
phrases.en: That player is like a beast during a game.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사납고 강하게 움직이는 사람을 비유할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figure of speech for someone who moves fiercely and powerfully.

phrases.en: Beasts of prey hunt at night.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동물이 먹이를 잡는 모습을 설명할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe an animal catching its prey.

explain_en: It is used for animals like lions, tigers, and wolves that fiercely hunt other animals. Someone who moves very strongly and roughly in a game is sometimes compared to one with '맹수 같다'. A gentle animal is called a '순한 동물'.

examples.en: Dinosaurs went extinct a very long time ago.
This bird might go extinct soon.
We have to protect animals that are dying out.
As the forest vanished, many plants became extinct.
People are working so that tigers don't go extinct.
Bones of an extinct animal are in the museum.

explain: 동물이나 식물이 완전히 사라질 때 써요. 그렇게 만드는 쪽은 '멸종시키다'예요. '멸종 위기'처럼 명사로도 뉴스에서 자주 들려요. 물건이나 문화가 사라질 때는 '사라지다'를 써요.

phrases.en: Many animals have gone extinct.
phrases.nuance_ko: 당하는 느낌의 '멸종되다'와 같은 뜻으로 많이 쓰는 능동형이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An active form widely used with the same meaning as '멸종되다'.

phrases.en: Tigers are on the verge of extinction.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스에서 가장 자주 들리는 명사 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The noun collocation heard most often in the news.

phrases.example: 사람들이 너무 많이 잡아서 그 물고기를 멸종시켰어요.
phrases.en: People caught so many of them that they wiped out that fish.
phrases.nuance_ko: 누가 그렇게 만들었는지 원인을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when saying who or what caused the extinction.

explain_en: Use it when an animal or plant disappears completely. The causing side is 멸종시키다. As a noun, it often appears in the news in phrases like 멸종 위기. For objects or customs that vanish, say 사라지다.

examples.en: Dinosaurs went extinct a very long time ago.

examples.ko: 많은 동물이 멸종할 위기에 놓여 있어요.
examples.en: Many animals are at risk of going extinct.
When the environment changes, some living things go extinct.
We are protecting tigers so they do not go extinct.
The bones of an extinct animal are in the museum.

examples.ko: 왜 매머드가 멸종했는지 궁금해서 책을 찾아봤어요.
examples.en: I was curious why mammoths died out, so I looked in a book.

explain: 주어는 동물이나 식물 같은 생물 종류예요. 사람 한 명이 죽는 일에는 쓰지 않아요. '멸종 위기', '멸종 위기종'처럼 환경 뉴스에 많이 나와요.

phrases.en: This bird is in danger of extinction.
phrases.nuance_ko: 환경 뉴스에서 가장 자주 나오는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing in environmental news.

phrases.en: That animal has already gone extinct.
phrases.nuance_ko: 피동 형태로, 결과로 사라진 상태를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The passive form, describing the state of having died out.

phrases.en: We protect forests so animals do not go extinct.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-지 않도록'으로 막으려는 목적을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '-지 않도록' states the purpose of preventing something.
phrases.en_equiv: so as not to go extinct

explain_en: The subject is a kind of living thing, such as an animal or plant species. It is not used for one person dying. It appears often in environmental news, as in '멸종 위기' and '멸종 위기종' (endangered species).

examples.ko: 토끼는 한 번에 새끼를 많이 낳아서 빨리 번식해요.
examples.en: Rabbits have many young at once, so they multiply fast.

examples.ko: 세균은 따뜻하고 습한 곳에서 번식하기 쉬워요.
examples.en: Bacteria multiply easily in warm, humid places.

examples.ko: 이 새들은 봄마다 호수 근처에서 번식해요.
examples.en: These birds breed near the lake every spring.

examples.ko: 멸종 위기 동물이 동물원에서 번식하는 데 성공했어요.
examples.en: An endangered animal succeeded in breeding at the zoo.
I'm worried because the weeds have spread across the whole garden.
We need to get rid of the places where mosquitoes breed.

explain: 동물, 식물, 세균이 새끼나 수를 늘려 갈 때 써요. 사람에게는 보통 쓰지 않고 '아이를 낳다'라고 해요. '늘어나다'는 무엇에든 쓸 수 있지만 '번식하다'는 생물에게만 써요.

phrases.en: Weeds have strong reproductive power.
phrases.nuance_ko: 생물이 수를 늘리는 힘을 말하는 명사예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A noun for how strongly a living thing multiplies.

phrases.en: Spring is the breeding season for birds.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동물이 새끼를 낳아 수를 늘리는 시기를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The time of year when animals breed.

phrases.en: I air out the room often so mold doesn't spread.
phrases.nuance_ko: 세균이나 곰팡이가 늘지 않게 막으려는 목적을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Expresses the purpose of keeping germs or mold from multiplying.

explain_en: It is used when animals, plants or bacteria increase their numbers or have young. It is not normally used for people, who simply 아이를 낳다 (have children). 늘어나다 works for anything, but 번식하다 is only for living things.

examples.en: The puppy has fleas on its body.
Fleas jump very high.
I got bitten by fleas and my legs itch.
I applied medicine to get rid of the cat's fleas.

examples.ko: 벼룩이 생기지 않게 자주 빗질해 줘요.
examples.en: I brush it often so fleas don't appear.
I bought a used book at the flea market.

explain: 작은 곤충이라 보통 반려동물 이야기에서 나와요. '벼룩시장'은 영어의 flea market을 옮긴 말로, 중고 물건을 사고파는 곳이에요.

phrases.example: 그 적은 월급까지 떼어 가다니, 벼룩의 간을 빼 먹는 일이에요.
phrases.en: take from someone who has almost nothing
phrases.nuance_ko: 가진 것이 거의 없는 사람의 것까지 빼앗는 야박한 행동을 나무랄 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to criticize someone who takes even from those with almost nothing.
phrases.en_equiv: take from the poorest of the poor

explain_en: It is a tiny insect and mostly comes up in talk about pets. 벼룩시장 is the Korean version of 'flea market', a place to buy and sell second-hand goods.

examples.ko: 요즘 날씨가 변화무쌍해서 옷을 고르기 어려워요.
examples.en: The weather is so changeable these days that it's hard to choose what to wear.

examples.ko: 이 게임은 상황이 변화무쌍해서 지루하지 않아요.
examples.en: The situation in this game keeps changing, so it's never boring.

examples.ko: 변화무쌍한 시장에서 살아남으려면 빨리 적응해야 해요.
examples.en: To survive in a fast-changing market, you have to adapt quickly.
That actor is famous for his versatile, ever-changing acting.
The weather in the mountains really changes all the time.

examples.ko: 그 가수는 무대마다 변화무쌍하게 스타일을 바꿔요.
examples.en: That singer changes her style dramatically from stage to stage.

explain: 날씨, 시장, 상황, 표정처럼 모습이 계속 크게 바뀌는 것에 써요. 단순히 '자주 바뀌다'보다 바뀌는 폭이 크고 다채롭다는 느낌이고, 반대말은 '한결같다'예요.

phrases.en: You have to watch out for ever-changing weather in the mountains.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 앞에 오는 활용형으로, 날씨 이야기에 가장 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: The form before a noun, and the most frequent pairing is with weather.

phrases.en: That actor's expressions are truly ever-changing.
phrases.nuance_ko: 해요체로 문장을 끝낼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The polite form used to end a sentence.

phrases.en: The situation keeps changing, so it's hard to make a plan.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이유를 말하며 문장을 이을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to link sentences by giving a reason.

explain_en: It is used for things like weather, markets, situations or expressions that keep changing a lot. Compared with simply 'changing often', it suggests wide, varied changes; its opposite is '한결같다' (constant).

examples.en: That person's intentions seem impure.
Be careful of people who approach you with ulterior motives.

examples.ko: 물이 불순하니까 그냥 마시면 안 돼요.
examples.en: The water isn't pure, so you shouldn't drink it as it is.

examples.ko: 요즘 날씨가 불순해서 비가 자주 와요.
examples.en: The weather has been unsettled lately, so it rains often.

examples.ko: 동기가 불순하다는 말을 들으니 기분이 나빴어요.
examples.en: I felt bad when I heard that my motives were impure.

examples.ko: 불순하게 들릴지 몰라도 솔직히 돈 때문에 시작했어요.
examples.en: It may sound impure, but honestly I started because of money.

explain: 사람의 마음이나 동기에 쓰면 나쁜 속셈이 있다는 느낌이고, 물질에 쓰면 다른 것이 섞였다는 뜻이에요. '날씨가 불순하다'는 날씨가 변덕스럽다는 말이고, 반대말은 '순수하다'예요.

phrases.en: Be careful of people who approach you with impure intentions.
phrases.nuance_ko: 나쁜 속셈이 있다는 뜻으로 가장 많이 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing, meaning a hidden bad motive.

phrases.example: 요즘 불순한 날씨 때문에 옷 입기가 어려워요.
phrases.en: It's hard to dress these days because of the unsettled weather.
phrases.nuance_ko: 날씨가 자주 변해서 안정되지 않을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the weather changes often and is unsettled.

phrases.en: I filtered the impurities out of the water.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물질에 섞인 다른 것을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for foreign substances mixed into a material.

explain_en: Used for a person's heart or motives, it suggests a bad hidden intention, and used for a substance, it means something else is mixed in. '날씨가 불순하다' means the weather is unsettled, and the opposite is '순수하다'.

examples.en: This country has a lot of mountainous terrain.
I joined a hiking club with my friends over the weekend.
The weather changes often in mountain regions.
My father likes mountain biking.

examples.ko: 산악 구조대가 길 잃은 사람을 찾았어요.
examples.en: The mountain rescue team found the lost person.
You must be careful of mountain accidents in winter.

explain: '산악'은 '산'보다 크고 넓게 이어진 산 지역을 가리키는 한자어예요. 혼자 쓰기보다 '산악 지대', '산악 자전거', '산악회'처럼 다른 말 앞에 붙여 써요. 한 개의 산을 말할 때는 그냥 '산'이에요.

phrases.en: The northern part of this country is a mountain region.
phrases.nuance_ko: 산이 많이 이어진 넓은 지역을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a wide area with many connected mountains.

phrases.en: My father goes hiking with a mountain club.
phrases.nuance_ko: 함께 산에 오르는 모임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A group of people who climb mountains together.

phrases.en: I go mountain biking on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 산길을 달리는 자전거를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A bike made for riding on mountain trails.

explain_en: 산악 refers to broad mountainous country rather than a single peak. It is rarely used alone and mostly attaches to other words, as in '산악 지대', '산악 자전거' and '산악회'. For one mountain, just say '산'.

examples.ko: 태풍 상륙 소식에 학교가 문을 닫았어요.
examples.en: Schools closed after the news that the typhoon would make landfall.

examples.ko: 태풍의 상륙이 예상돼서 배가 모두 돌아왔어요.
examples.en: With landfall expected, all the boats came back.

examples.ko: 그 가게는 한국 상륙을 앞두고 준비가 한창이에요.
examples.en: The store is busy preparing for its arrival in Korea.
The wind was strongest right after landfall.
Korean movies' arrival in Japan was a success.

examples.ko: 바다에서 올라온 거북이들의 상륙 장면을 봤어요.
examples.en: I saw the scene of sea turtles coming ashore.

explain: 태풍이 육지에 닿을 때 가장 많이 들어요. 배나 군대가 땅에 오를 때도 쓰지만 일상에서는 드물어요. 해외 브랜드가 새 나라에 들어올 때 '한국 상륙'처럼 비유로도 써요.

phrases.en: The typhoon will make landfall on Jeju Island tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: '상륙'의 동사형으로 일기 예보에서 가장 많이 들어요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form of 상륙, heard most in weather forecasts.

phrases.en: The typhoon is expected to make landfall in the afternoon.
phrases.nuance_ko: 곧 올 것으로 보이는 때를 알릴 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to announce when something is expected to arrive.

phrases.example: 그 커피 가게의 한국 상륙 소식에 사람들이 기뻐했어요.
phrases.en: People were happy about the news of that coffee shop's arrival in Korea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 해외 브랜드가 새로 들어올 때 쓰는 비유예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A figurative use for when a foreign brand enters a new market.

explain_en: You hear it most often when a typhoon reaches land. It also describes ships or troops coming ashore, but that is rare in daily life. It is used figuratively too, as in '한국 상륙' when a foreign brand enters Korea.

examples.en: The typhoon will make landfall on Jeju Island tomorrow morning.
The soldiers landed on the coast at dawn.
The new product has finally arrived in Korea.

examples.ko: 배에서 내려 섬에 상륙하는 데 십 분이 걸렸어요.
examples.en: It took ten minutes to get off the boat and land on the island.

examples.ko: 태풍이 상륙하기 전에 창문을 고정해 두세요.
examples.en: Secure the windows before the typhoon makes landfall.

examples.ko: 외국 커피 체인이 서울에 상륙한다고 해요.
examples.en: I hear a foreign coffee chain is landing in Seoul.

explain: 상륙하다는 바다에서 땅으로 올라온다는 말이라서 태풍과 군대 뉴스에 가장 많이 나와요. 새 상품이나 가게가 처음 들어올 때도 '한국에 상륙하다'로 비유해서 써요.

phrases.example: 그 해외 브랜드가 드디어 한국에 상륙했어요.
phrases.en: That foreign brand has finally landed in Korea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새 상품이나 브랜드가 처음 들어올 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a new product or brand first enters the country.

explain_en: 상륙하다 means to come from the sea onto land, and appears most in news about typhoons and the military. It is also used figuratively when a new product or shop arrives, as in '한국에 상륙하다'.

examples.en: This river is the water supply source for the nearby city.
Fishing is restricted near the water supply source.

examples.ko: 상수원을 보호하려고 공장이 들어서지 못하게 했어요.
examples.en: They blocked factories from being built in order to protect the water source.

examples.ko: 상수원에 기름이 흘러들어서 큰 문제가 됐어요.
examples.en: Oil flowed into the water source and became a big problem.
If the water source is polluted, tap water is affected too.

examples.ko: 상수원으로 쓰는 댐이라 들어가면 안 돼요.
examples.en: It's a dam used as a water source, so you can't go in.

explain: '수원지'와 비슷하지만, 상수원은 특히 수돗물로 쓸 물을 가져오는 곳을 말해요. 뉴스에서는 '상수원 보호 구역'이라는 말이 자주 나와요.

phrases.example: 이 호수는 상수원 보호 구역이라서 수영할 수 없어요.
phrases.en: This lake is a water source protection zone, so you can't swim here.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스와 안내문에서 가장 자주 나오는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most frequent phrase in news and signs.

phrases.example: 시에서 상수원을 보호하려고 공장 건설을 막았어요.
phrases.en: The city blocked the construction of factories to protect the water source.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물을 깨끗이 지키는 일을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when talking about keeping the water clean.

phrases.example: 이 댐의 물을 상수원으로 쓰고 있어요.
phrases.en: The water from this dam is used as a water supply source.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 물을 수돗물의 원천으로 쓴다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means using certain water as the source of tap water.
phrases.en_equiv: to use as a water source

explain_en: It is similar to '수원지' (water source), but '상수원' specifically means where water for the tap supply is drawn. In the news you often hear '상수원 보호 구역' (water source protection zone).

examples.ko: 우주에서 생물체를 찾는 연구가 계속되고 있어요.
examples.en: Research looking for organisms in space is continuing.
The sea still has many unknown organisms.
I observed a tiny organism under a microscope.

examples.ko: 모든 생물체는 물이 있어야 살 수 있어요.
examples.en: All living things need water to live.

examples.ko: 그 행성에는 생물체가 없는 것 같아요.
examples.en: There seems to be no life on that planet.

examples.ko: 스스로 빛을 내는 생물체를 영상으로 봤어요.
examples.en: I saw a self-glowing organism in a video.

explain: 생물체는 살아 있는 것을 과학적으로 말할 때 쓰고, 사람, 동물, 식물이 모두 들어가요. 일상에서는 보통 '동물', '식물'처럼 따로 말해요. '외계 생명체'처럼 '생명체'도 비슷한 뜻으로 써요.

phrases.en: Could there be living things on other planets too?
phrases.nuance_ko: 비슷한 뜻이고, 우주나 지구 밖 이야기에서 더 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar in meaning, and appears more often in talk about space or other planets.

phrases.en: I saw a very tiny organism under the microscope.
phrases.nuance_ko: 크기나 특징을 앞에 붙여 어떤 생물인지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a size or trait in front to describe what kind of organism it is.

phrases.example: 연구팀이 깊은 바다에서 새로운 생물체를 발견했어요.
phrases.en: The research team discovered a new organism in the deep sea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 과학 뉴스나 연구 이야기에서 '발견하다'와 함께 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used with 발견하다 in science news and research talk.

explain_en: 생물체 is used scientifically for anything alive, covering people, animals and plants. In daily talk people usually say 동물 or 식물 separately. 생명체 is used in a similar sense, as in 외계 생명체 (alien life form).

examples.en: The river water makes a whirlpool, spinning round and round.
When I poured milk into the coffee, a swirl formed.
The boat nearly got sucked into the whirlpool.
The sink water swirls as it goes down.
That matter grew into a big turmoil.

examples.ko: 마음속에 소용돌이가 일어서 잠을 못 잤어요.
examples.en: Turmoil rose inside me, so I could not sleep.

explain: 물이나 바람이 빙글빙글 도는 모양 말고, '혼란의 소용돌이', '논란의 소용돌이'처럼 큰 혼란을 비유할 때도 많이 써요. 동사 '소용돌이치다'로도 써요.

phrases.en: get swept up in the turmoil of an incident
phrases.nuance_ko: 큰 사건이나 혼란에 얽혀 빠져나오기 어렵다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Being pulled into a big event or confusion and finding it hard to get out.
phrases.en_equiv: get caught up in a whirlwind

explain_en: Besides spinning water or wind, it is often used figuratively for big turmoil, as in '혼란의 소용돌이' and '논란의 소용돌이'. There is also the verb '소용돌이치다'.

examples.en: Old thermometers had mercury inside.
Mercury is a metal that is liquid at room temperature.

examples.ko: 수은 체온계가 깨지면 조심해서 치워야 해요.
examples.en: If a mercury thermometer breaks, you have to clean it up carefully.

examples.ko: 바다 생선의 수은 농도가 뉴스에 나왔어요.
examples.en: The mercury level in ocean fish was on the news.
The light of the mercury lamps lit up the street brightly.
I heard fish can be contaminated with mercury.

explain: 체온계 이야기에서 많이 듣는 금속 이름이에요. 독성 때문에 '수은 중독', '수은 오염'처럼 환경과 건강 뉴스에도 나오고, 가로등 이름 '수은등'에도 들어 있어요.

phrases.example: 집에 있던 수은 체온계를 안전하게 버렸어요.
phrases.en: I safely threw away the mercury thermometer we had at home.
phrases.nuance_ko: 예전에 쓰던 체온계를 말할 때 가장 먼저 떠오르는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The first pairing that comes to mind for the old kind of thermometer.

phrases.en: Mercury poisoning is very dangerous for the body.
phrases.nuance_ko: 건강 뉴스에서 독성 문제를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in health news to talk about toxicity.

phrases.en: The mercury lamps were on along the night road, so it was bright.
phrases.nuance_ko: 길을 비추는 옛날식 가로등을 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to old-style street lamps that light the road.

explain_en: It is the metal you hear about most in talk of thermometers. Because it is toxic, it also appears in environment and health news as '수은 중독' and '수은 오염', and it is part of the word '수은등' (mercury lamp).

examples.ko: 닭의 수정란은 따뜻하게 두면 병아리가 돼요.
examples.en: A chicken's fertilized egg becomes a chick if kept warm.
In science class, we observed frog fertilized eggs.
The fertilized egg grows as its cells divide.

examples.ko: 수정란 하나가 쌍둥이로 나뉘는 경우도 있어요.
examples.en: Sometimes a single fertilized egg splits into twins.
A new life begins inside the fertilized egg.
When I shone a light on the fertilized egg, I could see inside.

explain: 과학이나 생물 수업에서 주로 쓰는 말이에요. 먹는 달걀 가운데 수정이 된 것은 '유정란'이라고 해서 식품 이야기에서는 이 말을 써요.

phrases.en: The fertilized egg grows in a warm place.
phrases.nuance_ko: 수정란이 점점 커지고 변하는 과정을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the process of a fertilized egg growing and changing.

phrases.en: I found frog fertilized eggs in the pond.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 동물의 것인지 앞에 붙여 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the animal's name before it to say whose egg it is.

phrases.en: Fertilized eggs are a bit more expensive than regular eggs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먹는 달걀 가운데 수정된 것을 식품 이야기에서 이렇게 불러요.
phrases.nuance_en: In talk about food, fertilized eggs sold for eating are called this.

explain_en: It is mostly a word for science and biology classes. Among eggs people eat, one that has been fertilized is called a '유정란', which is the word used when talking about food.
